title: Wrap and Loft
tagline: Wrap curves onto the profile, offset them along its normal, and loft a strip -- sidewall and core-edge reference surfaces that follow rocker and camber.

slides.title: What it does
slides.problem: A reference surface that follows the profile through the thickness needs the wrapped curve and a matching offset curve, lofted -- with no gaps where source curves meet. Wrap and Loft does all of it in one feature.
useWhen: A strip of set height along the profile
Planar sources (the From path is made for you)
slides.caption: Primary 20 + second 5: a 25 wide strip along the To normal.

points.head: Arc length kept
points.body: A point s along the From reference lands s along the To reference (a shift, no scaling).

points.head: Height and width kept
points.body: The point's offsets in the frame carry over: ribs stay perpendicular.

points.head: Layers bend
points.body: At height h around radius R they stretch or shrink by (R - h) / R, as a real layer does.

slides.title: The dialog
params: From edge(s) (G1 chain) and From reference (vertex, mate connector, plane).
To edge(s), Flip (reverse To), To reference, Flip normal.
Frenet (default) / Binormal (face, mate connector or world axis).
Primary offset (20 mm), Flip offset direction, Second direction + Second offset.
As Wrap Curve, + Fix control-point clustering (on), Break spans, Exact ruled surface.

points.head: Planar shortcut
points.body: Planar sources: From edge(s) disappears; the From path is the To chain projected onto the source plane (wraps, not drapes).

points.head: Welds
points.body: Where curves meet, the later adopts the first's offset direction: no 0.35 mm gaps at seams.

points.head: Exact ruled (option)
points.body: An exact ruled B-spline instead of a loft where possible; changes face ids.

keys: One face per source curve, unioned.
messages: Only when it is off and slivers were found.

items.head: Negative offset
items.body: Use Flip offset direction; primary cannot be negative.

items.head: Planar check
items.body: A single straight source edge cannot define a plane: the flag keeps its previous value.

items.head: Failures
items.body: Loft / union failures are reported on the console only.
